newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain shares lose 1.4 percent in the week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain shares lose 1.4 percent in the week.

text.p: Bahrain shares fell 1.4 percent in the week ending on Thursday on sharply reduced turnover, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
The index fell to 1,525.52 points from 1,546.79 points.
More than nine million shares worth 1.58 million dinars ($4.2 million) were traded in the week, down from 16 million shares worth 2.9 million dinars the previous week.
Shares of 21 companies out of 39 registered in the bourse changed hands in 203 transactions.
The bourse said Bahrain Middle East Bank led the market with 4.37 million shares worth 400,277 dinars changing hands. It closed on Thursday at 90 fils, down from 92.5 fils.
The bourse said 297,005 shares worth 201,897 dinars of Investcorp were traded in the week. Its shares closed five U.S. cents down at $1.81 on Thursday.
Bahrain's market is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
